title: Possibility of the antibottom-strange molecular pentaquarks near $ BΣ$ and $ B^*Σ$ thresholds
summary: The molecular states in coupled channel system of $B_s^0N- BΛ- B^*Λ- BΣ- B^*Σ$ are investigated within one-boson-exchange model that includes $S$-$D$ wave mixing and a tunable short-range $δ(r)$ term. Bound, resonant, and virtual states are searched by analytically continuing the $S$ matrix in the complex energy plane. In the single-channel analysis, the $ BΣ$ and $ B^*Σ$ systems with $J^P=1/2^-$ and $3/2^-$ are found to be attractive and form three bound states with reasonable cutoff region, corresponding to $1/2^-( BΣ)$, $1/2^-( B^*Σ)$, and $3/2^-( B^*Σ)$ .
